items.text: Zelenskiy confirms Ukraine hit Russian ship in Gulf of Finland.
Ukraine FM: Libya ship strike was self-defence, cites UN Charter.
Russian strike kills 2 in Odesa; drones hit Kyiv flats, 2 hurt.
Iran's Guards claim three tankers hit mines in Hormuz.
Sarkozy and Bruni ordered to stand trial in Libya witness case.
Real Madrid 5-1 PSV: Bellingham stunner, Mbappe brace.
Arsenal held 1-1 by Dortmund; Man City draw 2-2 with Napoli in Europe.
England beat Australia by 8 wickets in 2nd T20I; Donald 85 off 32.
Sooryavanshi, 15, sets List A record with 204 off 53 balls for India A.
Asia stocks slide 2.3% as AI rebound fades; Nvidia falls 5.9%.
Australia Oct CPI hotter than expected; trimmed mean inflation 3.8%.
Solomons to swap China defence treaty for Australia pact.
Fiji declares nationwide disaster amid an El Nino dry spell.
COP31 fallout: Pacific nations accuse Australia of climate betrayal.
Trump pardons Thanksgiving turkeys Freedom and Feathers.
Trump awards Rudy Giuliani the Medal of Freedom.
Fort Hood shooter Hasan seeks stay of execution.
Radar outage delays flights at Chicago O'Hare, FAA says.
Abrego Garcia to leave US voluntarily, US media report.
US court clears army to detonate toxic explosives in Iowa.
Houthis push to 60 km from Aden; forces say city will hold.
Iran to ration electricity as war damage deepens gas shortage.
Israeli strike kills Hamas security chief Abu Nahel in Gaza City.
Senegal regains its 2025 AFCON title after CAS ruling.
Rebel group pulls back from DR Congo areas after clashes.
Nigerian emir suspended after sexual assault allegation.
Armed men hold dozens hostage in a Cartagena supermarket.
Car bomb in Colombia injures at least 23 people.
Xiamen Airlines orders 50 Boeing 737-8 jets.
BJP and Akali Dal announce alliance for 2027 Punjab elections.
